reviews.text: I’m so happy with my experience at Dankroft K9! Everyone there is genuinely lovely, and the entire staff is so welcoming and helpful. The facilities are really cool, and I couldn’t be happier with the service. I’ll definitely continue working with them for occasional training sessions and would highly recommend them to anyone!❤️

🐾 Puppy Manners & Socialization Program — SUCCESS! 🐾

We are so proud of Beretta for completing the Puppy Manners & Socialization Program, and we couldn’t be happier with our experience at @dankroftk9! ❤️

A huge thank you to @dk9nathan for his incredible training, patience, guidance, and support throughout this journey. Nathan made learning how to train Beretta fun for us, too! He took the time to listen to us, understand our challenges, and work with us to teach us how to navigate them with confidence. We never felt alone in the process. The support, encouragement, and guidance we received from Nathan and the entire team were truly amazing.

The training facility and the team are absolutely fantastic! Their dedication, knowledge, and genuine care for both the dogs and their owners make such a difference. Training was always a positive and enjoyable experience, and Beretta absolutely LOVED it! He was always so excited for his sessions that he would practically run us right to the door as soon as we arrived! 🐾❤️ Seeing his excitement and progress throughout this program has been so rewarding.

We are incredibly thankful for the complete support we received, not only in teaching Beretta but also in teaching us how to become better, more confident handlers. Having a trainer who listens, understands, encourages, and genuinely wants to see you succeed is priceless.

We are SO happy we chose @dankroftk9 for this journey! Thank you, Nathan, and the entire team, for everything you have done for us and Beretta. This is just the beginning, and we can’t wait to continue learning, growing, and training with @dk9nathan and the team! 🐶❤️

Highly recommend @dankroftk9 to anyone looking for knowledgeable, supportive, and dedicated trainers who truly care about setting both dogs and their owners up for success! 🐾👏

#DankroftK9 #DK9Nathan #PuppyManners #PuppySocialization #DogTraining #CaneCorso #Beretta #TrainingJourney

Today our puppy graduated with flying colors. The team at Dankroft were absolutely amazing, wonderful classes and support from them even outside of class hours. Always keeping in touch and making sure all of our questions were answered. We couldn’t have asked for a better place to assist us with her training!!

We adopted reactive and a little aggressive dog, so we start calling around to find some behavior training. Dankroft K9 was the only place who offered assessment before offering any training. Oriana (our trainer) is a real pro, I was a bit skeptical about some of exercise but I was wrong. Very professional approach, friendly communication. She did great job with us and our dog. If before people were crossing the road with their dogs when they see us, now everybody is complimenting his behavior.
Thank you Oriana and Dankroft k9 from Nick, Alex and Lennon)

We loved our training program at Dankroft K9. We worked with Oriana and learned so much. It was great to have private classes followed by group classes to really see our progress in action. We are grateful to DK9 for teaching us so much! 🙏

We brought our Australian Shepherd who was 8 months old at the time to Dankroft K9 and we would do it all over again! They helped us train our puppy with much care, professionalism, and gave us real training that worked and was attainable with our daily schedules. Our puppy is now 1 year old and she has grown so much since Day 1! We would recommend their services to anyone.

I sought out Dankroft earlier this year for behavior modification training for my 4yr old male mini-poodle, Theo. We did our training sessions with Oriana. The training and strucutre provided for home helped to improve Theo's reactivity. Unfortuantely, shortly after completing the training sessions I was hospitalized for a month. When I returned home, Theo had regressed (due to disruption of structure) and started to show some of his reactive behaviour again. Not understanding what to do, I reached out to Dankooft for some help. Dan came to perform a home assessment. I was provided with very explicit instructions on what not to do for the home visit so true natural behavior could be see. I followed the instructions, Dan was able to see the troubling behavior and he provided me with a reset training plan for Theo. Theo and I have been training with this reset plan for a couple weeks now and have been able to start redeveloping our bond. Thank you Dankroft for your commitment to what you do!
Thank you for the 5 stars Vasili!

We had an in-home training session and I am really happy with the experience. We worked on commands, interactions, reactions, walking and play. Bear is a Belgian Malinois mix with a LOT of energy, and one of the biggest things I learned was how important it is to teach him how to be calm.
Dan was paying attention to every detail of my dog’s body language and could see the signs before he reacted. He explained what he was seeing and what I should do, and also helped me understand that my own anxiety and emotions can affect my dog.
What I liked the most is that he is not only training the dog, but also teaching the owner how to understand their dog and build a stronger relationship. I really liked how much patience and understanding he have. I felt the whole session was with no judgement, and he really wanted to understand my dog and help us.
I left the session understanding my dog much better and with many things to keep practicing. More then happy and I really recommend them!
Thank you for the 5 star

Could rave about Nathan and this facility for ages! The behavior modification program was exactly what we needed, if you've stumbled across this in your search for a trainer, do not hesitate! My only regret is not starting training at Dankroft K9 the moment we brought our little dummy home. Huge thank you to Nathan for helping us learn how to channel Tuna's drive, how to set up our home for success between two dogs and a newborn, and most importantly, for giving us back the ability to just love and have so much fun with that brick headed girl. Excited to continue with this team in group classes, and hopefully some sport!

10/10 amazing and informative and our dog loves it so much and they are very knowledgeable and teach very well

We are still going and dont plan on stopping anytime soon!!!

Nathan and the whole team at Dankroft K9 are amazing, very knowledgeable, great communication, amazing at what they do, great facilities.. our dog loved it and she achieved great results. Would definitely recommend this business.

Every detail matters, everyone matters and every dog matters.

I’ve had the pleasure to attend seminars and iron dogs hosted but Dankroft and you very clearly and easily will:
1. Become family
2. Understand dog behaviour and have a healthier relationship with your dog.

If you need puppy lessons or behaviour modification please try them all their trainers are amazing!

We had such a great experience working with Oriana at Dankroft K9! My boyfriend and I were researching different training facilities in the area and we were so glad we chose Dankroft. I was specifically looking for a training centre that provided a longer training program- as a new puppy owner, I wanted to make sure we were setting Belle up for success. I had previously had a dog who struggled with anxiety and eventually became aggressive, so it was really important to us to find someone who could help us build a strong foundation for socialization, confidence, and good manners for our puppy. When I sat down with Nathan to have our first consultation, he really made me feel confident about this program and when we started, Oriana got straight down to business. She was professional, very knowledgeable, gave us practical tools that were easy to understand and, most importantly, easy to continue applying at home. She was very upfront with what we needed to work on each session and made it fun and that’s exactly what we were looking for! The group sessions were phenomenal for us because Belle got to experience controlled and structured scenarios with other dogs which would’ve been unlikely to be able to do while we were out by ourselves otherwise.

The team was also very helpful when we were struggling and having a mental break down at home with crate training and took the time to give us advice and suggestions outside of our regular sessions.

We can genuinely see a difference in her behaviour and in our confidence as owners. We’re really grateful for everything we’ve learned and would highly recommend Dankroft K9 to anyone looking for a professional, patient, and practical approach to puppy training. We’re now looking forward to putting our pup in their next off-leash course soon!

Thank you Oriana and the Dankroft team!!

Highly recommend Dankroft! We got a puppy leonburger and our trainer was Oriana. She was amazing she always answered all our  questions and always took the time to explain everything and troubleshoot through all our puppy issues. Dankroft is also not a yelling facility all  trainers have a very calm approach to educating owners and training dogs. I'm very thankful to have found the Dankroft team. Will 100% be bringing my next dog to Dankroft. Also felt that the puppy socialization program was very well structured, I loved how we always got a end of class summary and training videos to refresh our memory.

I started with Dankroft K9 Services March of 2025.
I did the 12wk course with "August" and found out this boy was not without experience in obedience and agility. We have advanced in doing the protection work with the expertise of John and Nathan. I have seen great results in my boy, and have told them that they are stuck with August and myself. You are treated as family and your dog(s), well being is definatly a true concern. To all the trainers August and myself have had the privilage of working with
Sincerely
Thank you
Lesley & August
Incredible services.

We enrolled our dog, Sheru, in Dankroft’s behaviour modification training classes after he began displaying reactive behaviours. From the very first session, Oriana was patient, knowledgeable, and genuinely invested in helping both Sheru and us succeed.

She took the time to understand Sheru’s specific triggers and explained the reasoning behind each exercise and how we can use them in his routine and different situations, which made us feel much more confident continuing the training at home. Her approach was compassionate, practical, and tailored to Sheru’s needs.

We’ve noticed a lot of progress in Sheru’s behaviour, and we’ve learned how to better understand and communicate with him. Sheru had to be re-crate trained, it was a struggle at first, but it became a lot easier with practice and consistency. He also got a lot better at staying on ‘place’ when there are certain triggers going on around him. Behaviour modification takes consistency, but Oriana gave us the knowledge and confidence to continue working with Sheru after the classes ended.

We’re so grateful for her guidance and would highly recommend Oriana and Dankroft to anyone looking for a knowledgeable and caring dog trainer!

We brought our rescue dog Rufus to Dankroft for obedience training and worked with Nathan for the last couple of months. Nathan was very knowledgeable and patient during our training. Our dog Rufus is a street dog who pulled aggressively on the leash and had zero baseline training before we began. After completing the 10 week course with Nathan, Rufus is a completely different dog from when we began with excellent leash training and obeying commands. All of the instructions provided to us have made us confident dog owners! Thank you again Nathan and team. Would HIGHLY recommend ☺️

I recently took Rocco, my Schnauzer, for an initial consultation to begin his training, and I had an excellent experience. The service was very professional, and the place, besides being very well maintained, inspires a lot of confidence.

We also had the opportunity to chat with Dan, the owner, who is a very kind, attentive, and generous person with his time. I also loved that they speak Spanish! It made communication much easier, more comfortable, and smoother.

If you're looking for a professional place with a warm welcome and a team that truly cares about dogs, I definitely recommend Dankroft K9 without hesitation!
Very knowledgeable staff, prompt support and great customer service. Many training sessions for dogs all year round as well top of the line dog essential accessories 👍 Parking is a challenge though …

Dankroft's team is extremely knowledgeable and professional. I need to disclose, that I never purchased or exchanged anything for their services, but from a third party perspective of seeing my peers with dogs who were trained by their team, as well as any media showing their training, it's very evident that they  understand how to handle dogs properly, read a dog's behavior behavior, and create a confident dog.
I would HIGHLY recommend them to anyone in the area because they seem to be the best you can get.

I really cant say enough good things about Donkroft K9. I came to visit from the US and from the moment I began working with them, it was clear that they are experts at what they do, and put genuine care into the dogs and owners they work with.

Their training is structured, professionally, and very easy to understand and follow as a client. From my interaction with their team, it seems that they tailor every program to each individual dog instead of using a cookie cutter routine. You can really tell they have real experience reading, working with, and building up dogs.

What stood out to me perosnally most when  observing their team work wast he level of patience  and honesty throughout the entire process. They don’t just train the dog that they are working with, but they help you understand why and how training works the way it does - setting you up for long-term success having a confident dog.  HIGHLY recommend.

I just finished the basic training course with my dog Talia at Dankroft K9 and the results were amazing!! My young dog went from being unruly and wild to well-behaved and obedient in a matter of months. Nathan, the trainer I worked with, was phenomenal. He clearly loves dogs and has a deep understanding of canine psychology, with a very balanced approach to training. Talia loved the training sessions – they were positive, fun and effective. She especially loved Nathan!

I had already completed two other training programs with my pup, and neither was able to get her to follow basic commands. I was getting discouraged. She’s a working breed – a French Spaniel – so very high energy. Walking her anywhere on a leash was a nightmare – she would pull in every direction.

I knew it shouldn’t be so challenging to get her trained. Then I found out about Dankroft. I was initially worried they may just work with reactive dogs, but that’s not the case – they train all dogs, i.e., all breeds, sizes and demeanors. As well, they train not just the dog, but the owner, which is critical. I was taught the skills and techniques I needed to train my dog in a way that works.

So if you want a happy, well-trained dog, give them a call! I can't recommend them enough.

We tried other trainers. Do not waste your time. The team at DankroftK9 is fantastic. They catered the training to our pups specific needs and we are more than grateful for the support we received from them. From day 1 Nathan met us with determination and dedication to help us get the best possible outcome. His knowledge and approach is fantastic. The facility they have is awesome and the community behind it is even better. Our pup loved every class he had!

DK9 Team One is an incredible dog training facility. Dan is extremely knowledgeable, patient, and dedicated to the dogs he works with. Watching him train my dog Kutusa was amazing — you can clearly see the confidence, trust, and structure he builds with each dog. The improvement in behaviour, focus, and overall confidence was truly impressive. The atmosphere is professional, welcoming, and supportive, and it’s obvious the team genuinely cares about both the dogs and their owners. I highly recommend DK9 Team One to anyone looking for professional training and real results.

After extensively shopping around for training programs, I am so happy that I chose Dankroft K9 for training. I have a rescue dog that came with a plethora of quirks, making for the most challenging dog I’ve ever had.

Britt and Nathan worked extensively with my girl to learn what works best for her learning, such as how to encourage her good behaviours and how to correct her poor behaviours. I needed someone with who would meet us where we were at. I was seeking a program that tailored to my dog’s strengths and weaknesses and can confidently say that I found that. I knew that a program that came with a prescriptive program wouldn’t be the best for my dog, given her life history.

Training is not just about the dog, rather it’s about training the owner to train their dog. I didn’t want a program where I sent my dog off to be trained by someone else, I wanted my dog to respect me and strengthen our bond; again, I can confidently say that I found that.

I now have a bank of knowledge for not only my dog, but for all the future dogs who come into my care. I have learned how to work with my dog in a way that she requires. After this experience, I proudly endorse this service. I am tremendously happy that I chose K9 Dankroft, and am forever grateful for the care and attention that I received from their team.

We take feedback seriously and always welcome legitimate reviews. However, after reviewing our records, we are unable to confirm this reviewer had any genuine interaction with our business. Certain identifiers connected to this review also raise serious concerns about whether it is authentic.
We have reported the review to the platform for investigation. If the reviewer believes this is incorrect, they are welcome to contact us directly with verifiable information.
Thank you!
They have helped us and our dog so much.

We had an amazing experience working with Monica as our dog trainer for the puppy foundations program. She was incredibly attentive to all our questions and concerns, always taking the time to review our videos and give thoughtful, personalized feedback. She made us feel truly seen and heard—no question ever felt too small or silly.

What really stood out is how much she invests in her clients. She gave us practical tools that actually work, and made it clear that you get what you put into training. With her guidance, that effort felt manageable—and it was absolutely worth the cost.

Before the DK9 team, we tried other training programs that did more harm than good. We were honestly at a point where we didn’t think we could keep our dog. Now, our dog is thriving, and we have the skills to manage him and create a much better home environment.

We are so grateful we found DankroftK9 - shoutout to Monica, Oriana and Nate! highly recommend, you won’t regret it.
Thank you Josh

We brought our 9 year old pup for 10 sessions and it made a world of difference. We weren’t sure if she was too old to train, but Nathan and the team did an amazing job and succeeded at every stage of training. Thank you!!

Dk9 was so helpful for our dog Bella. Nathan was our trainer and at every session he showed up with amazing energy. He was patient, knowledgeable and kind. We learned skills that help us with everyday life with our dog and managing her behaviour. We saw noticeable changes with Bella and would highly recommend lessons and training here!! Thank you to the whole team!!

Very likeable and knowledgeable team. Nathan is an amazing source of information, and always ready to help, or teach when needed. The team provides a great environment for you and your precious loved ones to learn and practice skills together. Worth every penny, if I was rich I'd over pay.

Me, my husband, and rottweiler thoroughly enjoyed our time with Dankroft and the team.

Worth the drive from Niagara ! Amazing facility and even better staff. Not only do they know animals but trainers don't just teach "sit" and "stay"; they understand canine psychology. They pinpointed exactly why my dog was struggling and addressed the root cause. Cannot wait to continue to train my dogs with them :)

My 3 year-old pup and I recently completed the Dog Manners and Obedience Program. In addition to sharpening skills—and learning some new ones—it was a wonderful bonding experience. My pup has always been very timid; after even after just a couple of weeks, she gained so much confidence. And Nathan is awesome! We learned so much from him, and had fun doing it. We will definitely be returning for more courses. I cannot recommend Dankroft K9 highly enough.

I cannot recommend Dankroft enough! I have completed the behaviour modification program earlier this year and it has helped me rebuild my relationship with my dog. Our trainers Oriana and Nathan have been extremely supportive, knowledgeable, and helpful throughout the process.  Ever since completing the program, I have been continuing with the training through group classes and pack walks that they consistently run. If you are looking for a dog trainer and are serious about the relationship you want to build with your dog please spend your money wisely and put it towards dog trainers who are good at their job. Thank you to the Dankroft team for all the knowledge and support! We look forward to continuing with the classes in the new year!

I have spent thousands on trainers in the past with little results. Nathan at dankroft really knows what he's talking about and teaches the handler the structure necessary to foster a healthy relationship and reach the goals you desire when it comes to the training needs you require for your furry friend. Thank you Nathan and team for everything you've done when it comes to the training of my rotti.

I can't say enough good things about Dankroft K9. Our dog had been to multiple trainers before to deal with specific issues we were having but no amount of training seemed to help. Then we met Dan and Nathan. Dan did our initial consult and was able to figure out right away what my dog (and we) needed to do in order to improve our situation. Then Nathan trained us for 6 weeks, each week challenging us to do more and more, in ways that taught both our dog and ourselves, and by the end of it, our dog was an absolute dream. Nathan is what we can only describe as a natural at this job. He has truly found his calling and we would recommend his training to everyone we know (and we've already done so)! Thanks Nathan, Dan and the whole Dankroft team. We'll be back for some more advanced training soon!

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Highly Recommend Dankroft K9!
We recently took our dog Nate—a foster fail we decided to adopt—to see Dan at Dankroft K9 for an evaluation. Nate is approximately three years old, a Bully/Presa cross who spent over 400 days in a shelter, so finding the right trainer was really important to us.
Our visit with Dan was exceptionally positive. He took the time to sit with Nate and me, asked thoughtful questions, and clearly explained how he could help us. He gave us tons of valuable information and several practical strategies we could start using right away.
What impressed me most was Dan’s honesty and integrity. Even though we had driven 2 hours to see him, he recommended another trainer—someone he trusts—who is only an hour from where we live. He encouraged us to meet with them as well and choose whichever option best fits our needs. That level of professionalism and genuine care is rare and incredibly admirable.
I would highly recommend Dankroft K9 to anyone looking for an excellent, knowledgeable, and truly sincere dog trainer. Dan clearly has a passion for helping dogs and their people succeed.

I sought help from this facility after noticing that my dog, Chapo, was reactive toward male dogs. From the very first session, Nathan was clear, professional, and extremely knowledgeable. He knew exactly what we needed and consistently adjusted our training program based on both my progress and Chapo’s.

The facility itself is clean, spacious, and fully equipped with everything required for effective training. Chapo improved tremendously throughout our sessions and so did I. He was always excited to walk through the doors, which says a lot about the environment they’ve created.

I would highly recommend this facility to anyone looking for quality dog training. Nathan and his team truly care, and the results speak for themselves.

Our 4 year old Bernese Mountain Dog, Muddy Baby, recently completed the Dog Manners & Obedience Program at Dankroft K9 with a 91.5% score!  We are very thrilled!

Past couple of years, we’ve always joked that Muddy Baby was a C+ student, having taken a few different trainers’ programs and approaches around the city (we tried a lot of different schools of thought and ideologies). We weren’t fully satisfied with those schools and kept searching.

When we were first recommended to try out Dankroft K9, we were worried that maybe this school was too advanced or not the best fit.

Immediately upon our first intro meeting at Dankroft K9, we saw their passion and knowledge on full display! They explained to us how to best help Muddy Baby grow and learn; how she could thrive with some more structure and skills. They taught us new techniques that we were lacking as dog parents.

We quickly saw Muddy Baby grow from a shy, slightly anxious and generally well-behaved dog into a confident, eager and happy-to-work dog.

Muddy Baby loved working and learning with Oriana and Monica, who took the time to answer all of our many questions, even did a house call when we early on were struggling to transfer things we learned at Dankroft K9 to home.

For me as a dog parent, getting clear instructions on how to best communicate with Muddy Baby, and then immediately seeing results gave me confidence and a deeper bond with Muddy Baby.  What I didn’t expect from this whole experience was how much closer it brought us together (I am welling up as I type this), I feel like we all understand each other so much better now.

I’d recommend Dankroft K9 to anyone regardless of their dog’s age or behaviour if you want to see them grow to their full potential or if you just want to grow a deeper understanding of their feelings and thinking.

When my partner and I recently moved into a condo, I quickly realized how much we needed help with Nyla’s reactivity. She would lunge and bark at other dogs, and even simple things like taking the elevator were stressful. I used to get anxious just taking her outside and would PRAY the elevator went straight to the ground floor to avoid running into people or other dogs. A neighbour on my floor who is a previous client of Dankroft, recommended them to me and I’m so glad we listened.

Our trainer was Oriana, and I really cannot say enough great things about her. It has been an absolute pleasure. She is incredibly knowledgeable about dogs, especially German Shepherds like Nyla (she has one herself!), and it’s so refreshing to work with someone who genuinely wants to see not only your dog succeed but you as a handler as well. Oriana clearly loves what she does, and it shows in her work. She is such a positive light and she will 100% be seeing us again for the next program!!

A huge thank you to Oriana and the Dankroft team, Nyla no longer barks or lunges at other dogs or people,  not even when other dogs are barking and lunging at her, which is crazy to think about considering how she was just a couple of months ago. Coming out of this program, I can confidently say I’ve built a much stronger relationship with my dog and we’re super excited to continue to work with the team through other programs!

Dan from Dankroft  is an amazing trainer.  Dan came out of his way to come all the way north to our home to help us with our dominant female shepherd, who has had it out for our female Malinios from the time we brought her home.

I’m a trainer myself and I can openly admit I was at a loss in this situation, there is no room for ego when even us trainers are struggling with our own dogs. For 3 years we have tried seeking help from other trainers in this matter but not getting anyone really willing to help. We felt hopeless that we would never be able to have the girls even able to go for leash walks together. It all seemed impossible. But we knew we were not willing to rehome either of the dogs.

Working breeds and dominant dogs is a whole other ball park than your average pet dogs. Dan took the time to assess our home environment and how we
Interact with each of our dogs.  He pointed out the areas we need to change in order to have harmony in our home, while working us through step by step.

Dan is very knowledgeable in behaviour modification and explains things very clearly in a very calm and patient manner. I was struggling with some PTSD from past fights and he was there to coach and help me through each step, showing me how to be more confident in these exercises.

What seemed impossible became possible with Dan’s guidance. Our girls can now at least coexist around one another. This experience had me in tears of relief, gratitude, and hope. Thank you so much Dan for not only being a great trainer but a great colleague and friend. ❤️

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Beginning with the Dankroft K9 Team has been incredible right from the start! The team was amazing from day one, and we’re so grateful to have gone through their puppy program. Our puppy is now nine months old, has an amazing demeanor, great boundaries, and fits perfectly into our family. Highly recommend!

Amazing trainers even better people! I would highly recommend Dan, Nathan and everyone else that works at Dancroft K9, as a professional trainer myself I would trust them with my dog, hands-down, easy, five stars for them!
Very professional. Excellent training. Would recommend to anyone with a dog that needs training!!

HIGHLY RECOMMEND!!! 10/10

Dan at Dankroft went out of his way to help me, coming
to my home - when a situation came up with my pup & 1
needed help.

I most likely still have Ollie today thanks to Dan.

Working breeds & bully breeds can be a whole other
animal compared to the avg dog you come across day
to day. Everything I learnt at Dankroft I use daily, every
little thing. It has helped beyond words.

My trainer was Nathan, Dan's son. Nathan was amazing
to work with. You can tell everyone at Dankroft has a
genuine passion for these dogs. It's tough work &
they're doing an incredible job.

Thank you Dan.
Thank you Nathan.

Ollie's owner

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Dankroft Obedience’s puppy program is honestly one of the best! My dog Canelo loved going every week — he would come home happy and tired, sleeping like a baby after class. He always looked forward to Friday night training! A huge thank you to Dankroft and especially oriana and Monica for always giving me the best advice and taking the time to answer all of my questions. We will definitely miss training nights, but Canelo will be back for daycare and boarding (dog moms need a break too!). Highly recommend Dankroft Dog Obedience to anyone looking for caring, knowledgeable, and effective training.

We highly recommend Dankroft K9 Services. Our hound, Rooster (approx 1 yr old), has come so far. He listens so much better, and we feel confident taking him anywhere. The classes are fun and informative. Oriana, our trainer, is really awesome. Everyone we’ve met there has been great, including the owner. We couldn’t be happier, and we are only halfway through our classes!

We had a wonderful experience with Dankroft K9! Our trainer, Oriana, was patient, kind, and incredibly knowledgeable. She took the time to really understand our dog, Loki, and even adjusted our training based on his specific needs, which made all the difference. Oriana gave us the tools and confidence we needed to improve our relationship with him, and the results have been amazing—we are so grateful for this experience. She always took the time to respond to all our questions and never rushed our sessions. Thank you, Oriana and the Dankroft team! We look forward to doing more classes in the near future and would recommend them to anyone who is looking for dog training!
Great staff!

I came to Dankroft K9 on a recommendation from a friend, and wow! She wasn't wrong.
I chose them primarily because they speak Spanish, and for me, communication in Spanish is much easier and more fluid, so this is a plus.
But I've had a wonderful and pleasant experience; it's a wonderful school.
I arrived with my Ozzy, a playful and difficult puppy to walk, who couldn't be around other people, especially children. But after his training with Nathan, he's undergone an extraordinary change for the better. Now he's a calm, focused, and well-behaved dog.
Thanks to Nathan, I was able to learn to understand and train my Ozzy more easily, and he became a super-behaved dog, capable of controlling his impulses and very focused on us. This makes our walks fun and enjoyable.
Now he can be around anyone without any problems, he has great control, and listens to our calls to obey.  Thanks again to Nathan and Dankroft K9. They're a wonderful school where they educate you and your dog, and above all, where you can see results. I will always recommend them 100%.

I came to Dankroft K9 on a friend's recommendation, and wow! She wasn't wrong. I chose them mainly because they speak Spanish, and for me, communication is much easier and more fluid in this language, so that's a big plus. But I've had a wonderful and pleasant experience; it's a fantastic school. I arrived with my Ozzy, a playful puppy who was difficult to walk, and he couldn't be around other people, especially children. But after his training with Nathan, he's changed dramatically for the better. Now he's a calm, focused, and well-behaved dog. Thanks to Nathan, I was able to understand and train my Ozzy more easily, and he's become a super well-behaved dog, capable of controlling his impulses and very focused on us. This makes our walks fun and enjoyable.
